exact_parity.scope: Existing exact comparator report for all measured steps; large tensor receipts are not reloaded or rehashed.

count_semantics.tensors: Every compared tensor, including floating, integer and boolean tensors; exact_tensors counts torch.equal successes.
count_semantics.scalars: Python floating scalars only; exact_scalars counts exact equality for these floats. This does not count every scalar or token.
count_semantics.uncounted_values: Token IDs and other integer, boolean, string and structural values are recursively checked, including dictionary keys and sequence lengths, without contributing to the floating-scalar count.

cuda.scope: Exact listed production qualification selectors. Suite compilation and duration are not performance evidence.

cli.scope: Exact listed production qualification selectors. Suite compilation and duration are not performance evidence.
cli.scope_difference: Tiny depth-2 real RustBPE CLI uses 16 MiB cache/minfree0; performance pair uses 256 MiB/minfree4GiB. Test asserts reexec, exact fork state/optimizer/RNG, standalone evaluation, uninterrupted state/optimizer equality, and per-worker zero-retention reports. JUnit success authenticates these pinned assertions; this generator does not reload checkpoint tensors or independently identify CLI child-worker PIDs.

policy_cpu.scope: 38 initial successes plus the Gloo case rerun with sandbox networking allowed and CUDA hidden. The initial Gloo failure was socket permission denial.

qualification.cpu_source_boundary: CPU runs preceded the pinned commit. Four existing completed-resume cases and the default-settings case were rerun after the final small branch/type-narrowing changes; these repeat cases are included in the 342, not additional cases. CUDA and CLI qualification in each pair bind the committed production tree.

profiler_compatibility.scope: Additional ignored native CUDA qualification at the production commit: record_shapes/profile_memory enabled, three cache hits, exact native gradients and RNG, zero owned-object survivors before profiler exit. No trace or throughput claim.

earlier_evidence.scope: Historical proof and prototype screens are separate from production timing and qualification. Their timings are not substituted for the native production measurements.

limitations: One RTX 4090, one fresh process per arm/workload, five short and three full-budget measured updates, reversed arm order; no randomized campaign or confidence interval.
Performance uses a linear head; separate CUDA/real-CLI checks cover a depth-2 residual head, without a depth-2 production-throughput claim.
No full-suite, Hopper, distributed speedup, natural allocation-failure recovery, or campaign-wide throughput claim.
One-second ownership polling cannot exclude subsecond compute, graphics work, or host contention. Startup residency gaps remain in the pair receipts.

Cache admission/copies/guards/live-head replay/cleanup are timed. Persistent decoder staging, loading, serialization, checkpoint/restart, validation and telemetry are outside complete compute-update timing.
